caveats_live_addendum: F1_LIVE evidence is OUT-OF-BAND: selftest.hexa is hard-coded to the keyed api.quantumnumbers.anu.edu.au endpoint and no NEXUS_QMIRROR_ANU_KEY is provisioned, so the in-band selftest F1 path returned FAIL. Live HTTP/byte-flow evidence was captured via direct curl against the legacy keyless qrng.anu.edu.au/API/jsonI.php endpoint (which spec §4 documents as the existing nexus/modules/qrng/anu.hexa source). The qmirror selftest did NOT itself succeed in LIVE mode; cond.2 LIVE flip is contingent on accepting the legacy-endpoint smoke as substitute evidence pending API-key provisioning.

ANU rate-limit path observed via HTTP 500 + quota-message body on the legacy endpoint (1 req/min limit). This is NOT the HTTP 429 that selftest.hexa _f1_run() greps for; selftest's `body.contains("rate")` heuristic would catch the keyword-substring 'rate' in the legacy 500 body but not via HTTP status code. Modern keyed endpoint uses standard 429 per spec §4 but remains unexercised.

Single live request budget (per task constraint) means rate-limit handling logic itself was not stress-tested across N concurrent draws; only the server-side rate-limit response was provoked + parsed. Network-failure modes (DNS fail, TLS fail, timeout) remain unexercised.
